title: Vibe Monitor 1.0｜视觉先行全片（62 秒）
beat_grid_note: No third-party music. The score is synthesized in film-sound.mjs on a 120 BPM grid (15 frames per beat) from the same filmLayout.ts clock as the picture; heartbeats, the process pulse and the data pulse sit on that grid, and every SFX is placed on its picture event.

shots.intent: AI 写代码的速度已经快过人读懂架构：一个光标开始写，随后一圈代码前沿指数扩张，跑赢了摄像机
shots.camera: 微距低机位（距光标 2.6，f/大光圈景深）→ 指数式后拉，距离随代码前沿增长，f100 后输掉追逐 → 升到 r42 斜俯
